consequence.statement: KVStoreMesh is enabled by default in Clustermesh after upgrade unless the value is explicitly set to false.
consequence.remediation: Set clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false explicitly during the upgrade to keep it disabled.

assertion.statement: The Helm value clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled now defaults to true (KVStoreMesh enabled by default in Clustermesh); set it to false explicitly to disable.
